test_title: PYST 60: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All wings are whites.

No whites are wands.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some wings are wands.

II. No wand is a white.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8b2d1bf805f3a5cffb7ba643b14f3a78738c5df7cb53be816be24d0f54ab186.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some wings are wands → **False** (All wings are whites, and no whites are wands implies that no wings are wands).

II. No wand is a white → **True** (No whites are wands implies that no wands are whites).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only conclusion II follows"**.
